
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Returns the index offset specifying the underlying buffer index of the first
    iterated element for each ndarray in a provided list of ndarrays.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: Array<ndarray>
        List of ndarrays.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<integer>
        Index offsets.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/zeros}}( [ 3, 3, 3 ] );
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    [ 0 ]

    See Also
    --------
